messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected in dedicated pool 'dp-7' (region-us-west). 1200 errors/min, 98th pct latency spiking. Auto-escalation -> paging sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now — switching to #incident-bridge in 2m.

leo-eng: joining bridge. quick ask: is this multi-tenant or a single-tenant pool?

sre-oncall: dp-7 is shared dedicated pool; repeated noisy-tenant pattern. initial correlation showing one tenant namespace 'monarch-prod' causing sustained 100% GPU memory growth on some nodes.

kirti-pm: @carla-csm looping CSM in case Monarch is impacted on their side. we should prepare a customer-facing note if they see latency.

carla-csm: thanks. i'm pulling Monarch's support metrics — they have ~4000 qps from prod during this window. any ETA on mitigation?

raj-eng: root cause hint: their model runs long context evals and we see KV-cache retention blowing up because of an unbounded session. logs show repeated requests with sequence_len 32768 then no truncation.

maria-accounts: paging billing: if we move them to reserved nodes temporarily, we need finance ok for surge credits. can we estimate hours?

inc-bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.example/incident/3830001234 — incident severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting, multiple tenants). Auto-trace: collect-stack, collect-dd, snapshot-kv.

leo-eng: mitigation plan (fast): 1) throttle monarch-prod to 30rps per-token 2) pin their pods to isolated nodes 3) kick an immediate migration to a small reserved pool (monarch-temp) 4) enable prefix-KV pruning for their sessions. executing step 1 now.

sre-oncall: applied rate-limit rule: 
```yaml
route: monarch-prod
max_rps: 30
burst: 5
```
applied via config push id: cfg-98321.

sre-oncall: Confirming: error rate dropped ~65% in last 90s. latency 95th is trending down.

raj-eng: starting live move of monarch pods to reserved nodes: `infra-migrate --src dp-7 --tenant monarch-prod --dst reserved-mono-1 --io-throttle 100mbps`

leo-eng: running `kubectl drain` on affected nodes with `--ignore-daemonsets` and `--delete-emptydir-data` flags. watch CPU/GPU.

kirti-pm: Carla, please ping Monarch CSM with an interim FYI: short mitigation action taken (rate-limits + migration) and we may perform a brief rollback window. Ask if they saw errors. Copy legal if needed.

carla-csm: sending note now. Draft: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency for your production requests; we've applied traffic limits and migrated some workloads to a reserved pool to stabilize service. We'll follow up with RCA and any credits if SLA impacted." sending to Monarch contact: taylor@monarch.example.

maria-accounts: rough estimate for migration window: 45–90 minutes. if they want the reserved pool longer we can convert to a 24h temp reservation and invoice later — recommend 24h for stability.

inc-bot: telemetry snapshot complete. tail of relevant logs: 
```
2026-11-03T14:02:11Z monarch-prod request id=abc123 seq_len=32768 mem_use=12.1GiB kernel=kv-cache-alloc
2026-11-03T14:02:12Z eviction: prefix_cache tenant=monarch-prod freed=0 entries=0 cause=locked-session
2026-11-03T14:04:03Z runtime OOM guard triggered on node gpu-07, killing pod monarch-prod-5
```

raj-eng: moved 12 pods, migration reported as successful. reserved-mono-1 now running at 60% capacity. errors for other tenants reduced to baseline.

sre-oncall: recommend keeping monarch on reserved-mono-1 for 24h while we do full RCA and apply per-tenant KV pruning policies. also recommend creating a hard session TTL for prefix caches.

kirti-pm: next steps for customer comms: 1) timeline and immediate mitigation summary 2) technical RCA draft 3) exec summary for Monarch leadership + proposed service credit 4) internal postmortem and remediation plan. who owns the RCA draft?

leo-eng: i'll own the technical RCA draft. will include memory traces, kernel selection misbehavior, and suggested runtime guard changes.

carla-csm: i'll own the customer comms and exec summary with help from maria-accounts for credit calc.

maria-accounts: preliminary credit calc: Monarch SLA 99.9% monthly. observed ~40m elevated errors affecting ~8% of their requests during the incident window. ballpark credit = (minutes_unavailable / minutes_in_month) * monthly_fee -> propose 1.5 days credit subject to legal.

sre-oncall: summary for bridge: incident mitigated at 3830001510 (-> rate-limits + migration). monitoring for 2 hours. opening post-incident channel: #post-3830001234-rca for docs.

carla-csm: Monarch replied: they saw increased 500s starting 14:02 UTC, appreciated quick mitigation, asked for an ETA on root cause and whether this could happen again.

leo-eng: rough RCA bullets I will expand: - Customer session-level unbounded KV retention allowed memory to escalate - Runtime didn't enforce prefix TTLs for long-context sessions - No per-tenant circuit-breaker for sustained mem growth - Mitigation: per-tenant memory caps, session TTL, and guarded eviction policies; add alert for continuous growth >5m.

raj-eng: adding an immediate rule to runtime: `--tenant-mem-cap=12Gi --oom-shepherd=true`. will ship canary to us-west in next 90m.

kirti-pm: please include an explicit ask for a scheduled follow-up meeting with Monarch leadership and a proposed customer credit in the comms. I'll prepare exec briefing slide once we have the RCA draft.

carla-csm: sending interim email now (short): "We've stabilized your traffic and moved you to reserved capacity. We'll send a full RCA within 48 hours and propose appropriate credits. Would you be available for a 30-min call tomorrow 16:00 UTC?"

maria-accounts: noted. i'll prepare the preliminary credit calc and attach a small worked example for review.

inc-bot: Reminder: open actions: [leo-eng: technical RCA draft due in 24h], [carla-csm: customer exec note due in 24h], [raj-eng: runtime canary & memory cap rollout], [sre-oncall: monitor & confirm stability for 2h].

sre-oncall: monitoring green for 18 minutes, all tenants stable. closing bridge in 30m unless regressions. great work team. :clap:

carla-csm: Monarch accepted call for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. I'll include Kirti and Leo.

leo-eng: starting RCA writeup now. will include timeline, logs, snippets, and proposed code changes. sample snippet for comms: 
```
Timeline:
14:01 UTC - Increased error rates detected by monitoring
14:03 UTC - Rate-limits applied to tenant monarch-prod
14:07 UTC - Migration to reserved pool started
14:23 UTC - Migration completed, errors dropped to baseline
```

maria-accounts: prepping credit calc doc. initial ask: offer 1.5 days of service credit; will flag to legal for approval.

sre-oncall: note for postmortem: update runbooks to include tenant isolation flow and faster reserve-pool provisioning (target <10m).

kirti-pm: thanks all. I'll move items into the postmortem board and tag owners. leaving bridge now.

sre-oncall: bridge closed. we'll re-open if anything changes.
